caption: A locked medium-wide shot in a quiet railway waiting room shows one distinctive traveler: a young woman with a blunt silver bob haircut, round black glasses, a mustard-yellow coat, a vivid turquoise scarf, and a small burgundy hard-shell suitcase covered by one white crescent-moon sticker. She stands beside a green wooden bench and gently turns the suitcase handle. Soft daylight, realistic cinematic video.
